label: Loading
depicts: Incomplete circular loading ring with a gap near the top right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple circular loader made from one incomplete stroke.
avoid_when: Do not use for the dotted or multi ray spinners when the ring should stay as one arc.

label: Loading
depicts: Twelve spoke loading star with short rounded rays around a center
use_when: Use when the interface wants a loader made from separate short rays instead of one ring.
avoid_when: Do not use for circular arc or dotted spinners when the spoke shape matters.

label: Loading
depicts: Pale circular track with a dark progress arc near the top
use_when: Use when the interface wants a loader with a visible background track and a highlighted active arc.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain ring when the light track behind the dark arc is visible.

label: Loading
depicts: Circular ring with small dots spaced around the outer edge
use_when: Use when the interface wants loading shown through a ring of separate dots.
avoid_when: Do not use for arc or spoke loaders when the dotted ring is the intended cue.

label: AI Search
depicts: Open magnifying glass ring with a spark star floating at upper right
use_when: Use when the interface wants the loosest search symbol with an open ring and an external spark cue.
avoid_when: Do not use for magnifying glass icons when the lens is open and the spark floats outside.
